Name: Elemental Force
Author: poaskkiliaks
Description:
Legends speak of the [i]Amphora[/i], a mysterious artifact capable of channeling the raw essence of elementals—beings of untamed power that govern fire, water, earth, air, and beyond. Now, this ancient relic is within your grasp, ready to transform your adventure into a tale of mystical discovery and elemental mastery.


﻿
